methods.role: exact, population, and narrow class-duty resolution order

supported_uses: Use exact measured or contractual hourly resource intensity when available
Use the paired 5,000-pound electric and propane hourly values only for a compatible capacity and operating duty
Use the grid-to-work and propane work-intensity values only when the useful-work boundary is explicitly modeled
unsupported_inferences: A universal forklift hourly resource intensity
Battery size, charger size, shift schedule, or annual hours
A 5,000-pound comparison applied to a different capacity or duty without a compatible authoritative population
Diesel, gasoline, or hydrogen performance inferred from the electric and propane pair
provenance_notes: The report states that forklift usage varies and that operating data are scarce.
The paired hourly record is therefore a narrow screening record, not a universal material-handling default.
